The route as the manifest prints it: python3 data/reproduce/reacquire/reacquire.py --grid idc_spine_mets_ct_seg; on the grid, from ~/spinesurg-ct-nnunet/data_platform/reacquire, sbatch -D "$PWD" --export=ALL,IDS="idc_spine_mets_ct_seg",MODE=--run reacquire.sbatch, as a Slurm job on the owner's word.
